summary: Iteration 9 verified: availability API restricted to 'available'/'full'; legacy statuses rejected (422); Full blocks booking with 409; Available allows multiple bookings without changing status; delete bookings keeps status Available. Admin CalendarTab exposes only A/F actions with correct data-testids; no slot selector/Tutup/limited controls. Mobile 390px renders 'A'/'F' compact labels without overflow. Public AvailabilityCalendar renders green (bg-emerald-100) for available and would render red for full. BookingForm messages match spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still contains dead helpers `availability_status(remaining_slots)`, `clamp_availability_to_team_capacity`, and `team_capacity` that reference legacy slot logic; safe to remove for clarity.

AdminDashboard.jsx CalendarTab hardcodes status default to 'available' when record missing but colors bar via `status ? COLORS[status] : bg-slate-200` — the ternary is unreachable since status is always truthy; minor dead code.
seed_data_creation: Test date 2027-09-15 used for availability/booking flows; all TEST_* bookings and availability record cleaned up via test_cleanup fixture and DELETE /api/availability/2027-09-15 (verified empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Availability endpoint now returns only {date,status: available|full}; no remaining_slots or limited/closed. Booking date validation only guarded by 'full'. AdminDashboard CalendarTab uses testids calendar-available-YYYY-MM-DD and calendar-full-YYYY-MM-DD with A/F mobile labels via responsive sm:hidden classes. Public AvailabilityCalendar uses testid cal-day-YYYY-MM-DD with emerald/rose classes.
